teaser.en: Its violet flowers smell sweet, but it is the roots of this small bush tree that Diani healers dig up for malaria.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya urujuani yananukia vizuri, lakini ni mizizi ya mti huu mdogo wa porini ambayo waganga wa Diani huichimba kwa ajili ya malaria.

summary.en: *Mziji* is the violet tree, a small tree of the coastal bush with pale bark, scented violet flowers and winged fruits. The Digo of Diani boil its roots to treat malaria.
summary.sw: *Mziji* (kwa Kiingereza *violet tree*) ni mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani wenye gome jeupe-jeupe, maua ya urujuani yenye harufu nzuri na matunda yenye bawa. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kutibu malaria.

about.en: *Mziji* is a small tree with pale, smooth bark. In flower it is covered in sprays of violet or purple pea-like blossoms with a sweet scent. These are followed by distinctive winged fruits, each a small nut with a single curved wing that spins as it falls.
about.sw: *Mziji* ni mti mdogo wenye gome laini lililopauka. Unapochanua hufunikwa na vishada vya maua ya urujuani au zambarau yanayofanana na maua ya mbaazi, yenye harufu tamu. Baadaye hufuatwa na matunda ya kipekee yenye bawa, kila moja likiwa kokwa ndogo yenye bawa moja lililopinda, ambalo huzunguka linapoanguka.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland and bushland. The violet flowers make it easiest to spot when it is in bloom.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye miti na vichakani. Maua yake ya urujuani hufanya iwe rahisi zaidi kuuona unapochanua.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the roots to treat malaria. The violet tree is a well-known medicinal plant across much of Africa, and its roots are also known to be toxic, so it is a plant for experienced healers.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kutibu malaria. Mti huu ni mmea wa dawa unaojulikana sana katika sehemu kubwa ya Afrika, na mizizi yake pia inajulikana kuwa na sumu, kwa hiyo ni mmea wa waganga wenye uzoefu.

names.en: The Digo name is *mziji*. In English it is the violet tree; its scientific name is *Securidaca longipedunculata*. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mziji*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *violet tree*; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Securidaca longipedunculata*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Also used against malaria in Diani
reason.sw: Nao hutumika dhidi ya malaria huko Diani

reason.en: Horsewood, another bush plant used for malaria
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa porini (*horsewood*) unaotumika kwa malaria
Kichaka ambacho pia hutumika kwa malaria
